intro: We are interested in literature, visual culture, cultural memory and emerging creative practice, from emerging and established voices alike.
accept: Sketches, abandoned images, visual traces and marginalia
Short essays, notes and reflections on process
Works still searching for their final form
include: A short note on the work (up to 150 words)
The work itself, attached as a document or image files
otherEnquiries: Ananke Editions also considers proposals for books and experimental publications.
